## Overview

You'll become a production-ready OpenClaw specialist with a live, working deployment of a 24/7 autonomous AI agent proving real hands-on skills. Earn via freelance gigs, direct client contracts, or supporting businesses that want an always-on digital assistant of their own.

## What Is OpenClaw Hands-on Training?

OpenClaw Hands-on Training is School of Freelancing's 5-session, 5-day hands-on training for deploying and maintaining OpenClaw — an open-source, autonomous AI agent platform that functions as a 24/7 personal digital assistant. Trainees move from OpenClaw fundamentals and core architecture through environment setup, production deployment, and troubleshooting, then package that skill as a paid freelance service. Beyond deployment, the final session builds a full freelance launch pipeline: three marketplace profiles (Upwork, Guru, Freelancer), five OpenClaw service videos, LinkedIn/social marketing, job search and bidding strategy, and client communication and delivery — preparing freelancers to work as OpenClaw Support Specialists from day one.

## Why Join This Training?

Autonomous AI agents are one of the fastest-moving categories on Upwork, Guru, and Freelancer right now, and clients are actively searching for someone who can stand up a 24/7 digital assistant they actually own — not a subscription to someone else's platform. Most freelancers can't fill that request because they've never taken OpenClaw past a local demo. This 5-day sprint changes that: you leave with a production deployment, 3 marketplace profiles, and 5 service videos as instant proof of work, plus the job search and client delivery skills to convert that portfolio into paid work fast.

### You'll Leave With

1. Hands-on experience deploying and configuring a live, production-grade OpenClaw agent
2. Marketplace portfolio proving real deployment, troubleshooting, and client-support skills
3. Stronger habits for configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting autonomous AI agents under real workloads

## Training Curriculum: 20 Training Hours / 5 Days

5 days, 1 session/day, 4 hours per session.

| Session | Topic | Content |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | OpenClaw Fundamentals & Architecture | Core concepts, agent architecture, components, real-world use cases |
| 2 | Environment Setup & Installation | Server/environment preparation, OpenClaw installation, initial configuration |
| 3 | Production Deployment & Configuration | Deploying for live workloads, integrations, access & security basics |
| 4 | Troubleshooting & Client Maintenance | Common deployment issues, logs & diagnostics, updates, ongoing support routine |
| 5 | Freelance Launch: Marketplace & Delivery | Upwork/Guru/Freelancer profiles, 5 service videos, LinkedIn marketing, job search & bidding, client communication, delivery, capstone review |

### Guaranteed Minimum Income (GMI)

This training secures a **Guaranteed Minimum Income (GMI)** under two conditions:

- **Attendance Requirement:** Zero-leave attendance across all 5 training sessions is mandatory. The guarantee is automatically voided in the event of any absence, personal dropouts, or technical disruptions.
- **Active Marketplace Engagement:** Trainees must purchase the required connects or bids on freelancing platforms to actively apply for marketplace jobs.
